{{Top|leg}}
A '''parajoule''' was a standard unit of measurement for energy recharges at power stations. Service rates were measured in weighted price per parajoule. The average recharge price at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] power stations in the week leading up to the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] vote in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Vote Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|news/1337_1.html|Palpatine Sets Army Vote Date}}</ref> sat at 1.72 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]-per-parajoule, up from the previous week's average of 1.32 credits-per-parajoule, according to a study of over 12,000 of the planet's power stations. This was the largest price hike seen on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] capital in over 60 [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].<ref name="HNN55">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|life/1359_1.html|Recharge Prices Jump .4 credits}}</ref>
